name: Italian Pork Meatballs with Garlic-Parmesan Zucchini Noodles

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 220°C (425°F). Coat two large baking dishes with a thin layer of butter.
Wash, dry, and shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a large bowl. (Reserve a small handful of parsley for serving.)
Peel and mince garlic. Add half to the bowl with the parsley along with pork and spices. Using your hands, mix well to combine. (Reserve remaining garlic for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
6 cloves garlic
1.02 kg lean ground pork
¾ tsp oregano, dried
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
¼ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Using a rounded tablespoon measure, form the pork mixture into meatballs and divide between the baking dishes.
Place meatballs in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, turning once, until cooked through, 18-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and trim zucchini; use a julienne (or regular) peeler to make noodles. Place in a clean large bowl.
Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
Once the pot is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add reserved garlic and cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds.
Add zucchini noodles and spices to the pot. Cook, tossing occasionally, until zucchini noodles are just tender, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
½ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: While the zucchini is cooking, finely grate Parmesan.
When the zucchini noodles are just tender, add Parmesan to the pot. Continue to cook, tossing frequently, until cheese melts, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide zucchini noodles and meatballs between plates or bowls. Sprinkle with reserved parsley and enjoy!
